photos.c: Left: Junior Galley tackled everything from Marathon down to 4x400 in 1994.

The Belgrave Boys pose before the Winter's first Surrey League match at Wimbledon. Standing, left to right: Michael Manning and daughter, Ray Foley, Mick Graham, 'Gerry' Adams, John Mather, Rob Harding,Paul Roche, Junior Galley, a yawning John Gladwin who's seen it all before, Stu' Paton, Pete Gilbey, Tony Binda, Colin Preston, Roger Alsop, Charlie Dickinson, Marlon Anderson, Bruce Barton, Jesper Madsen, Alex Luce, Rex Bale, Steve Willimont, Tony Stone, Alan Mead, John Wasbrough. Kneeling: ?, Jim Estall, Markand Patel, Paul Graham, Peter McDonald, ?, Kevin Quinn, Amir Becirhodzic, Bernard Asante, Stephen 'Maggot' Quinn, John Wilson, Adam Jones.

Right: First stage in 1996 Belgrave Road Relay. The field turns the corner from The Causeway into Cannizaro Road and Dave Pamah (A1) is handily placed with Dave Beaver (A2) and Junior Galley (A3) bringing up the 'B' and 'C' teams not far behind.
Left: Junior Galley ran into 4th scoring position for the Bels when he passed Stuart Paton somewhere before the 20 mile mark.

(a) Walton AC's Hewitt-Jones and Surrey Road Relay, 13th September 1997.  Junior Galley (75) takes over from veteran Tony Binda (74).  Junior has left his staff in charge at the record store to help the Bels to a Surrey 'gold'.  Surely Tony would never have dreamed that he'd be back winning Senior Surrey medals again.
Right: "Got the time mate?" Hercules Wimbledon's Steve Badgery and Belgrave's Junior Galley check on their progress at the 12 mile point during the 1999 London Marathon.

The traditional team photo before the start of the first Surrey League Race. Back row - Bruce Barton, Geremew Wolde, Rex Bale, Mike Webb, Don Anderson, Gerry Adams, Darryl Ochse, Alasdair McLean Foreman, Roger Alsop, Adam Cowmeadow, Tony Barden, Kevin Quinn, Pete Gilbey, Harry Corbett, Erwenn Lemenager, Rob Harding, Andy Brown, Ted Pallant. Front row: Rob McHarg, Steve Clarke, Will Cockerell, Eric Hall (President), Junior Galley, Jamie Kirton, Elvis Rimdap, Roy Collier, Aldis Ulrych.
